caveats.title: Manager – AI Productivity Engineer
caveats.description: Location: Hybrid working, 3 days per week at VHQ, Crawley Hours: 37.5 hours per week, full time Contract Type: Permanent Salary: Competitive Closing Date: 14th April 2026 We review applications on a first come, first served basis and may close the application window early if we receive a high volume of applications. At Virgin Atlantic, we believe travel should feel different. Since day one, we have challenged convention and redefined what a modern airline can be. Today, as we continue to evolve into a more data and technology enabled business, we are investing in AI not as a trend, but as a practical driver of productivity, smarter decision making and meaningful change across our operation. This is an individual contributor role. You will not be leading a large team, but you will operate with a strong project delivery mindset. You will be accountable for investigating, shaping and deploying AI solutions from idea through to integration, influencing stakeholders and driving outcomes across the business. In a nutshell AI only creates value when it meaningfully changes how a business operates. As our Manager, AI Productivity Engineer, you will embed directly within business domains to turn prioritised AI use cases into secure, scalable and integrated solutions. You will combine strong technical capability with deep curiosity about how AI can enhance performance across multiple functions, from Finance and People to Sales and Customer teams. Working through our AI Ignite governance framework, you will take ideas that demonstrate clear strategic value and convert them into working, production ready solutions. Whether building agentic workflows, deploying enterprise AI applications or integrating tools through robust API architecture, your focus will be on pushing the dial on innovation while ensuring measurable business impact. This is not a theoretical AI role. The challenge is integration. Connecting platforms. Embedding AI into live workflows. Ensuring enterprise standards are met. Delivering productivity gains that endure beyond the pilot phase. Day to day Embed within business functions to identify high friction processes and prioritised AI opportunities Translate approved AI Ignite use cases into defined technical requirements and delivery plans Design, build and deploy AI enabled applications and agentic workflows using enterprise AI platforms Integrate AI solutions into operational systems and enterprise tools through secure API architecture Rapidly prototype, iterate and productionise solutions that deliver measurable productivity gains Redesign workflows to reduce manual effort and cognitive load Partner with Security, Architecture, Engineering and Data teams to ensure responsible and compliant deployment Upskill colleagues and leave sustainable AI capability within the teams you support About you Experience building and delivering AI, automation or software solutions that moved beyond experimentation and created real-world impact, whether in production environments, operational teams or scaled internal use. Integration of AI tools or applications into broader workflows or systems (e.g. via APIs, orchestration frameworks or automation platforms), or the ability to clearly articulate how this would be approached. Design of AI-enabled workflows, productivity tools or agent-based solutions that meaningfully improved how teams operate. A track record of translating ambiguous business challenges into defined requirements, delivery plans

analysis.match_summary: El rol combina arquitectura y gestión, pero requiere experiencia en Virgin Atlantic y no hay claro camino de crecimiento hacia liderazgo.
analysis.gaps: Experiencia en Virgin Atlantic, falta de claro camino de crecimiento hacia liderazgo

caveats.title: Project Manager - Data Analytics (Supply Chain)
caveats.description: Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Varian Medical Systems, a Siemens Healthineers company is seeking a highly analytical, technically skilled, and results-oriented Project Manager with a Data Analytics emphasis to lead strategic data initiatives within Varian’s Supply Chain Plan & Materials organization. In this role, you will drive high-impact analytics, digital transformation, and process-improvement projects that enhance supply chain visibility, planning accuracy, operational efficiency, and overall performance. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to convert complex data into actionable insights, streamline core planning and materials workflows, and embed a culture of data-driven decision-making across SCM Plan & Materials. **Preference is for a candidate who can be onsite 2 days/week at a Varian location** What You Will Do Lead cross-functional analytics and process improvement initiatives to optimize planning, purchasing, material flow, and overall supply chain performance. Analyze complex supply chain challenges using SAP data (MM, PP, MRP) and other enterprise systems to identify operational gaps, risks, and opportunities. Design, automate, and optimize data pipelines and reporting workflows to improve data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness across planning and procurement activities. Develop dynamic dashboards and visualizations (Power BI, Qlik Sense, etc.) to communicate performance trends, forecast accuracy, inventory health, material availability, and supplier performance. Collaborate with Material Master Data, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, Finance, and IT partners to ensure analytics initiatives align with business objectives and digital transformation strategies. Establish and maintain strong data governance practices across SAP and analytics platforms to support reliable, real-time decision-making. Champion analytics adoption and data literacy, enabling planners, buyers, and leaders to leverage insights in daily operations and strategic planning. Drive continuous improvement, documenting processes, standardizing data workflows, and implementing scalable solutions that enhance supply chain visibility and responsiveness. What You Will Have Bachelors degree in: Computer Science, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or related field and 3+ years of experience OR Masters degree and 1+ years of experience Proven experience in project management and data analytics within a supply chain, operations, or manufacturing environment. Advanced SAP expertise in planning and purchasing processes, including MRP, BOM management, source list/Info Records, and production planning (MM, PP, related modules). Track record of leading analytics and process optimization projects from concept through execution, delivering measurable improvements in performance. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and process enhancements. Proficiency with data visualization and analytics tools (Power BI, Qlik Sense) and data analysis languages/tools (SQL, VBA, Python, or R). High attention to detail and strong commitment to da

analysis.match_summary: El rol combina arquitectura, gestión y estrategia, pero requiere experiencia en SAP y Supply Chain. Borja tiene experiencia en arquitectura de datos y gestión estratégica, pero necesita desarrollar habilidades en SAP y Supply Chain.
analysis.gaps: Experiencia en SAP y Supply Chain, así como habilidades en Power BI y Qlik Sense.

caveats.title: ABAP Technical Lead
caveats.description: About The Job You're Considering As an ABAP Technical Lead, you’ll be a key member of the SAP Delivery Centre, responsible for providing strong SAP development leadership and expertise. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage complex SAP landscapes, and drive technical excellence. Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time. Your role Team Collaboration: You’ll work closely with the SAP Development team, including onshore and offshore resources, as well as consultants from Capgemini’s wider SAP practice. Technical Leadership: Your role will involve leading ABAP development efforts, ensuring high-quality solutions, and driving innovation across projects Solution Delivery: You’ll specialize in technical areas such as BRF+, UI5 and Mass Activity. Your focus will be on delivering all WRICEF elements (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) within an ECC6.0 PSCD system, utilising Tax & Revenue Management. You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone. Your Skills And Experience Strong SAP ABAP development experience. In-depth knowledge of BRF+, WebDynpro, WF, NetWeaver Gateway Services and ABAP Objects. Techno-functional expertise in SAP Tax & Revenue Management, HR, FI and CRM. Experience with SAP UI and Fiori. Leadership and people management experience. Exposure to cloud platform integration and development solutions. Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication abilities. We are a Disability Confident Employer Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. Please opt in during the application process. Your security clearance and pre-employment checks To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process. Make it real – what does it mean for you? You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclu

analysis.match_summary: El rol de ABAP Technical Lead en Capgemini combina arquitectura y liderazgo, pero requiere experiencia específica en SAP y ABAP.
analysis.gaps: Experiencia en SAP y ABAP, falta de enfoque en Data/AI/Cloud, y requerimiento de Security Check (SC) clearance.

caveats.title: Applications Lead
caveats.description: We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer. As an Applications Lead you’ll play a pivotal role in improving and supporting our Atlassian tools in the R&D Programs at Elekta. Working within the Engineering Tools Stream of the Process & Tools Team, you will be responsible for Atlassian software applications and the overall life cycle management of them, with particular emphasis on Jira Cloud. Working alongside the Continuous Improvement and Engineering Intelligence Streams, you’ll work directly with business colleagues across the teams within R&D to ensure the successful implementation and on-going maintenance, support and enhancement of Jira Cloud and related applications. What you’ll do at Elekta: Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Managing and implementing the design, deployments, operational performance and support of Atlassian software applications with a focus on Jira Cloud. Leading the overall evaluation, configuration, and deployment of enhancements to applications including apps and integrations, incorporating feedback received from streams within Process & Tools, business functions, SMEs, user groups and development teams. Supporting internal software applications roll-out and user adoption in business functions. Collaborate with other functions (e.g. PMO and IT Services) to support delivery and harmonise the overall support process, including incident and access request management, identifying opportunities to optimise and shift-left. Collaboration and coordination with external vendors. Governance documentation detailing the SDLC for the solution. Access model detailing the Roles & Permissions. License and maintenance documentation. Initiating and supporting with application assessments, including security, system validation, architecture, infrastructure, procurement and data privacy as needed. The right stuff: Excellent written and verbal communication skills Self-motivated, well organised and results driven What you bring: We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement—your unique skills and experiences might be exactly what we're looking for! Bachelors in Information Technology or similar area, or other relevant degree, or proven ability to work within these areas Demonstrable knowledge of Atlassian products with particular emphasis on administration and support of Jira Cloud in a medium/large deployment. Experience working in and an appreciation of agile/lean approaches and culture. Understanding the balance between empowering agile/lean teams and providing governance frameworks when using tools such as Jira. Vendor management. Experience managing both IT operations and investment budgets would be a bonus. What you’ll get: In this role, you will work for a higher purpose; hope for everyone dealing with cancer, and for everyone regardless of where in the world, to have access to the best cancer care. In addition to this, Elekta offers a range of benefits. Work Pattern (you are required to work from the Crawley HQ 4 days a week with 1 day WFH) Up to 25 paid vacation days (plus bank holidays) Holiday Purchase Scheme Private Medical Insurance Attractive Employer Pension Contribution Package Cycle to work scheme Life Assurance Onsite subsidized restaurant, offering budget-friendly dining Love electric (Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme) Hiring process We are looking forward to hearing from you! Apply by submitting your app

Full Time, Permanent Our client, a leading and long-established membership organisation, is seeking an exceptional Head of Membership Proposition to drive the evolution of its core membership proposition and deliver ambitious growth plans. This is a high-impact, strategic leadership role where you will act as the product owner and commercial lead for the organisation’s membership and loyalty offering. About the Role Reporting to a senior commercial leader, you will take ownership of the membership product strategy, including proposition design, pricing, segmentation, and loyalty frameworks. You will work cross-functionally with marketing, digital, commercial, and operational teams to ensure the membership offering is compelling, scalable, and commercially optimised. caveats.title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
caveats.description: Our client is a market leading business, backed by PE investors with a huge opportunity to continue on a strong growth path. A genuinely international business with roots in Brighton, the business has revenues in excess of c£200m, strong EBITDA and a strong balance sheet backed by a supportive investor will provide the foundation to growth and the doubling of EBITDA over the next 3-4 years. About the Role We’re looking for a driven and commercially minded FP&A Manager to play a key role in shaping financial planning and performance insight across the business. Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you’ll take ownership of core planning cycles, delivering high-quality budgets, forecasts, and forward-looking analysis that directly support strategic decision-making at executive level. This is a hands-on role at the heart of the Finance function, working cross-functionally to improve processes, drive consistency, and enhance how we plan, forecast, and analyse performance. About You We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset: Proven experience owning budgets and forecasts in a complex environment Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or PE-backed businesses Exposure to multi-entity and multi-currency environments Strong organisational skills with the ability to meet tight deadlines Confident communicator who can build relationships across teams A collaborative team player with a positive, adaptable approach Skills & Experience ACA or ACCA qualified with 3+ years post-qualification experience Strong financial modelling and analytical capability Ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights Experience with FP&A systems Interest or experience in using AI tools to improve efficiency and insight £70-80k depending on experience

analysis.match_summary: El rol combina gestión financiera y análisis de datos, pero requiere experiencia en FP&A y conocimientos en sistemas de planificación financiera. El salario es competitivo y la empresa tiene un crecimiento potencial.
analysis.gaps: El perfil de Borja no tiene experiencia directa en FP&A, pero su experiencia en gestión de datos y análisis puede ser transferible. También no tiene experiencia en sistemas de planificación financiera, pero puede aprender rápidamente.

Primarily, we prioritise sustainable, long-term growth and the happiness of both our people and our clients. We are dedicated to creating a better workplace for people, with an internal mission centred around creating the happiest, most forward-thinking agency to work for and with. We champion a culture of collaboration and innovation. Breaking traditional silos, we encourage our team to experiment, challenge norms, and think creatively. This environment nurtures not only our clients’ success but also the personal and professional growth of our team. By embodying this progressive model, we stand as a dynamic, adaptable, and visionary partner, ready to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of marketing. Our progressive approach nurtures the growth and satisfaction of our team, ensuring that they remain engaged, motivated, and empowered. We care deeply about our people, our partners, and our clients and we genuinely believe that agencies can and should do good. We are building an agency we can all be proud to play a part in. We’re looking for someone who’s naturally curious and motivated to grow. Someone who’s comfortable in a fast-moving environment where ideas are tested, refined and improved. You’ll be adaptable, open to feedback, and see change as an opportunity rather than a disruption. You care about doing work that delivers real impact, favouring smart, effective solutions over long hours for the sake of it, and you’re excited to keep learning, challenge what’s not working, and contribute to a collaborative culture that’s focused on progress and continual improvement. Job Role We’re looking for a dynamic and results-driven Paid Social/Media Manager - one who’s bursting with creativity, able to drive performance and support the wider team in their development. You will be responsible for leading large client accounts and working alongside more junior members of the team. You will be developing and implementing effective strategies to drive performance, increase engagement, and enhance brand visibility for our diverse portfolio of clients across various social media platforms. You will also be collaborating with other channel specialists to align marketing strategies and achieve overall client objectives. In this role, you’ll use your experience in developing and implementing successful Paid Social strategies across various platforms. You’ll be responsible for finding opportunities for clients to grow and engage their social media audiences. Additionally, you will develop and execute comprehensive paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Pinterest, TikTok (and more!) as part of our Paid Social Media Service. You’ll be an important part of driving commercial success for clients, working closely with other departments like PPC and SEO. You’ll also assess and analyse client data to determine areas of opportunity, generate reports and forecast future KPIs for clients to aid in growth. You'll also be responsible for building and maintaining trusting relationships with clients to ensure the social strategy aligns with their wider marketing strategy.
